objective: Reject invalid CPVS magnitude-error values from SNR qualification and add explicit VizieR-to-parent object identity provenance without weakening scientific acceptance criteria.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Source-backed Scientific Validation run 39583481592 completed the heavy acquisition and uploaded scientific-validation-heavy evidence.
Its derivation reported 741787 candidates, while the independent selection diagnostics reported 741785 for the corresponding row-wise finite/non-zero-magnitude predicate.
The independent membership audit reported 730184 published IDs, 730182 intersection IDs, 11605 candidate-only IDs, and published-only IDs 781603 and 781604.
The official VizieR ReadMe defines Table 4 ID as a catalog internal identifier in the range 1–781604 and ZTF as the object name; the pinned Table 2 parent contains 781602 rows.

baseline.description: Scientific gate remains unresolved; SNR derivation and independent membership audit disagree by two candidates, and two published IDs exceed the pinned parent row count.

expected_improvement: Non-finite SNR values are rejected explicitly instead of passing because NaN < threshold evaluates false.
Regression coverage proves blank and NaN magnitude errors do not qualify an object.
Membership audit records published ID-to-ZTF-name mapping, IDs outside the parent, and any parent ordinal/name mismatches.
The 11603 remaining candidate-only IDs remain visible and the exact-membership gate stays fail-closed.

correctness.before: Invalid SNR can pass the threshold guard when the computed SNR is NaN; derivation reported 741787 candidates versus 741785 in independent row-wise diagnostics.
correctness.after: Guard rejects non-finite SNR and regression test is added; execution pending CI.

scientific_validity.before: 741787 candidates; 730184 published IDs; 730182 intersection; 11605 candidate-only; 2 published-only.
scientific_validity.after: No full source-backed rerun yet. Exact membership remains unresolved; no acceptance criteria changed.
scientific_validity.evidence: GitHub Actions run 39583481592 logs; VizieR J/ApJ/932/118 ReadMe; PR #206 diagnostic crosswalk.

evidence: Added explicit math.isfinite(snr) check before threshold comparison.
Added regression test for blank and NaN magnitude-error values.
Added ID-to-ZTF-name parsing and parent row-ordinal cross-check to the independent membership audit.
CI and scientific contract checks are pending; no test pass or scientific resolution is claimed.

root_causes: Confirmed implementation defect: _snr_from_mag_error returns NaN for invalid errors, while the previous guard only checked snr < sigma; NaN comparisons are false, so invalid-error rows can qualify.
The remaining candidate-only membership discrepancy of 11603 IDs is not explained.

Published IDs 781603 and 781604 exceed the pinned parent row count of 781602; the ZTF-name crosswalk is being added to establish whether this is source-version drift or another identity inconsistency.

findings: Non-finite numeric results must be rejected explicitly before threshold comparisons.
Catalog-internal IDs and astronomical object names should both be retained for cross-catalogue provenance.
Fixing the two-object implementation discrepancy does not establish exact CPVS membership.
Do not change SNR thresholds or acceptance criteria merely to force count equality.

open_blockers: Await CI, lint/format, regression, and scientific-contract checks for PR #206.
Run the updated parent identity crosswalk against the heavy evidence and capture the two out-of-parent ZTF names.
Perform reproducible diagnostics for the remaining 11603 candidate-only IDs and identify the root cause before declaring exact reproduction.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not merge until required CI checks pass and the diagnostic code is reviewed.
Keep CPVS exact reproduction as a scientific validation blocker until the remaining membership discrepancy is explained.
Do not claim the candidate-only IDs are errors or new discoveries without object-level provenance and independent evidence.
